links.outcome: Extraction accuracy against expert-created reference standard
links.effect: SIFTING-T-stage achieved an accuracy of 90% (95% CI: 84-95) against the reference standard, comparable to the largest reasoning LLMs.
links.quote: SIFTING-T-stage achieved an accuracy of 90% (95% CI: 84-95) against the reference standard.

unlisted_practices: Segment-level processing with structured prompts and strict output control linking extracted findings to source text for traceability
Fully self-hosted quantized open-source LLM for data control

screen.reason: The study develops and tests SIFTING, an LLM framework designed to enforce output structure and full traceability back to source text references compared to conventional prompting strategies.

primary.practice: traceability and source text attribution via structured prompting
